decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.7596. Series context: trend strength 0.9587 and seasonal strength 0.2783; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.014); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.237.
